variants.headline: Looking back: company lays off many workers
variants.sub: Many workers have been laid off by {company}.
variants.body:
We return to {first_reported}. Our report recorded this: The company {company} had laid off many workers.

A large layoff is an employment decision, not a complete financial statement. Commercial readers should avoid assuming a specific saving, a decline in demand or the closure of the enterprise. A useful assessment distinguishes the known decision from the business conditions and future results that would need their own evidence.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

The conduct of {target} deserves scrutiny in relation to the layoff. This paper does not presume a financial cause, a compensation arrangement or the subsequent circumstances of those whose employment has been affected.

variants.headline: Looking back: a large loss of jobs at a company
variants.sub: The company {company} has carried out a large layoff.
variants.body:
Looking back to {first_reported}, this was the news: Many workers have been laid off by {company}.

A large layoff is an employment decision, not a complete financial statement. Commercial readers should avoid assuming a specific saving, a decline in demand or the closure of the enterprise. A useful assessment distinguishes the known decision from the business conditions and future results that would need their own evidence.

Time changes the distance from an event, not the need to judge it carefully. Any claim about improvement or deterioration needs more than a recollection of the original news.

The conduct of {target} deserves scrutiny in relation to the layoff. This paper does not presume a financial cause, a compensation arrangement or the subsequent circumstances of those whose employment has been affected.

variants.headline: Looking back: workers face a company layoff
variants.sub: The company {company} has laid off many workers.
variants.body:
The headline belongs to {first_reported}. Our original account recorded this: The company {company} had carried out a large layoff.

A large layoff is an employment decision, not a complete financial statement. Commercial readers should avoid assuming a specific saving, a decline in demand or the closure of the enterprise. A useful assessment distinguishes the known decision from the business conditions and future results that would need their own evidence.

What has changed since then should be examined against that original record. What has not changed is the need to distinguish an established event from the hopes or fears attached to it.

The conduct of {target} deserves scrutiny in relation to the layoff. This paper does not presume a financial cause, a compensation arrangement or the subsequent circumstances of those whose employment has been affected.
